because the original patch doesn't reserve additional credits for preallocation in case the MDT uses an ldiskfs fs w/o extents, because extra credits were accounted in the code only for extents, the IND case is left unmodified:

@@ -1832,6 +1881,8 @@ static ssize_t osd_declare_write(const struct lu_env *env, struct dt_object *dt,
                        credits += depth;
                /* blocks to store data: bitmap,gd,itself */
                credits += blocks * 3;
+               if (obj->oo_prealloc_writes)
+                       credits += OSD_BRM_ALLOC_SIZE - 1;
        } else {
                credits = osd_calc_bkmap_credits(sb, inode, size, _pos, blocks);
        }
